summary.text: Perry Warren is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 31 who has served since December 1, 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Perry Warren assumed office in the Pennsylvania House on December 1, 2016.
In the 2023-2024 session he was secretary of the Commerce and Government Oversight committees, vice chair of the Insurance Committee, and a member of the Judiciary and Transportation committees.
